correctness.rationale: For three ordered phases, gap derivatives equal -2f(u)+f(v)+f(w) and cyclic counterparts. Equilibrium requires common positive gap force with each gap in (0,pi). f_beta has exactly one interior maximum, so any nonsymmetric equilibrium repeats a rising or falling gap. Two falling equal gaps give a positive Hessian separation direction. Two rising and one falling imply beta=log(2t)/[(1-2t)(1+t)]<-1/(1+t)<-2/3, eliminating them for beta>-2/3. Nontrivial collision equilibria have positive growth eigenvalue 3e^-beta, and equilateral eigenvalues -3 f_prime(2pi/3) are positive for beta>-2/3. Gradient analyticity and Polyanskiy et al Lemma 2.2 prove almost-everywhere convergence to synchronization, avoiding unstable equilibria. Below -2/3 the equilateral quotient attracts a positive-volume basin; beta=-2/3 excluded. Independently checked derivative and equilateral eigenvalue.
